name: secaudit
description: Audits codebases for security vulnerabilities that AI coding assistants introduce in vibe-coded apps: exposed secrets, broken database access control (Supabase RLS, Firebase rules, Convex, Prisma tenant scoping), missing auth (incl. Better Auth), client-side trust, insecure payments, supply-chain risks (slopsquatting, compromised-but-unreported packages), AI/LLM and RAG risks, container hardening, and Expo / React Native / Python specifics. One orchestrator skill plus focused per-domain skills.
